Intention (in the sense of intentness). Signified.
The Angels attend only to... the ends, or to the intentions... and to the thoughts thence.
The Most Ancients... had no fear that others should know their ends and intentions...
It is believed to be a matter of civil prudence to speak, act, and show by the expression of the face, differently from what one thinks and intends.
Others cannot bend the mind thither.
An evil opinion and intention... Signified, Explained.
As spheres originate from loves... they originate from the intentions and ends for the sake of which the man so wills and acts...
Everyone is judged according to the end or intention.
The quality (of interior obsessions) may be evident if one attends to the thoughts and affections, especially to the interior intentions which they are afraid to manifest...
All evil which springs from... the intention or end of evil... is contrary to Divine order...
They who are in vastations, that is, they who have been in principles of falsity, and in a life of evil from falsity, and yet in good as to the intentions...
Such, therefore, as is the intention or end in discourse and in works, such is the life...
To
descend
= a mind to, or intention.
That which saves them is the intention of doing good...
That they intend nothing but evil. Signified, Explained.
For the evil which is thought against anyone, is intended; and as the alienated things cannot intend good, it is said that they intend nothing but evil.

(For) the man who has been alienated from good and truth intends nothing but evil... and that which he intends reigns with him, and therefore it is in all his thoughts... for the intention or end is the veriest life of the man. (Continued. See
To
think for good
= to intend; but, as it is said of God, it = to turn into good; for what God intends He does.
They intend nothing but evil, but the Divine turns it into good. Treated of, Explained.
For they intend nothing but good towards the neighbour... It is otherwise with those who are in evil... for they intend nothing but evil to the neighbour; if good, it is for the sake of self.
The interior good, and also the interior evil, which are signified by
man,
are those which are of the intention or end; for the intention or end is the inmost of the man.
The life of man is his love; and what he loves, he wills and intends; and what he wills and intends, he does. This is of the man...
The angelic Spirits regulate the punishment according to the intention in the deeds, and according to the will in the thoughts.
That the falsities from evil which are intended to be brought upon others redound... upon themselves. Signified.
As it is from a law of order that evil relapses upon those who intend the evil...

It often happens in the other life... that the evil which they intend for others relapses upon themselves... The good cannot take away the evil of the penalty, because they are then kept in the intention of good...
Jehovah brought back upon them the waters of the sea
= that the falsities of evil which they intended for the good relapsed upon them, from the presence of the Lord with those who are in good.
That the falsities of evil which they intend for others relapse upon themselves by a law of order. References.
If the end or intention is to do good for the sake of reputation...

All things which a man has thought, intended, and done from infancy, have added themselves to his life, and have made it; and have also formed such a connection among themselves, that one thing cannot be removed unless they are all removed...
In the Inmost Heaven (they perceive the Word) as is wont to be the case with an intention or end.
Hence the end
propter quem
, or the intention, is the man himself.
From thought alone with some intention...
The Angel... remove, as far as possible, evil intentions.
The external acts are such as are the intentions and thoughts...
With everyone there are... exterior and interior thoughts and intentions.

The thoughts... tend according to the intentions, or in the direction in which the man intends; for the thought... is like the external sight, in that it is turned... to where it is bent and intended...
It is the man's love which makes the intention...

The intention of a man, from which his internal sight or thought is determined, is his will; for what a man wills he intends; and what he intends he thinks. If, therefore, he intends Heaven, his thought is determined thither...

The thoughts... which proceed from the intention or will, are (there) represented by ways. Ways are also presented... exactly according to the thoughts of the intention; and everyone walks according to his thoughts which proceed from intention.
Deceit enters more inwardly into the thoughts and intentions, and infects them with poison.
The man who examines himself... must examine his thoughts, and the intentions of his will.
Hence from the deeds of a man others judge of the thought of his will, which is called his intention.
There are many things of wisdom; as... thought, intention to a thing... These are indeed of both (love and wisdom), but they are denominated from the more prevalent and near.
The mind... aims the eye to see.
There are some... who strain the mind to explore...

The spirit is examined no otherwise than by the man attending to his thoughts, especially to his intentions; for the intentions are the thoughts from the will. Evils are there in their origin and in their root; that is, in their concupiscences and in their delights... That to think from intention is to will and to do, is evident from...
Man knows his own thoughts and thence his intentions, because he sees them in himself.
By thinking and willing, and also by intending, but still not by doing...
The love of the will inflows into the understanding... thence it comes into the thoughts, and also into the intentions...
But... when man is allowed to think the evils of his life's love even to intention, they are cured by spiritual means...
In proportion, then, as he resists the evils, he does not admit them into his intentions, and at last not into his thoughts.
The reason man is permitted to think evils even to the intention of them, is...
Spiritual light discloses the thoughts... spiritual heat the affections... and spiritual light and heat together the intentions and endeavours.
The works of the mind are intentions and endeavours...
As the intention which is of the will is primarily regarded by the Lord...
The soul inclines in both will and thought; that is, in intention...

The end goes forth from the will, and produces for itself a cause in the understanding, and presents to itself an intention; and an intention is as an act before determination. Hence it is, that by a wise man, and also by the Lord, an intention is accepted as an act.
With these, a conjugial life is the purpose, intention, or end...
Because a man is such a man as he is in his purpose, intention, or end...
They who separate these two in perception and intention...
All are contemplated from the purpose, intention, or end...

That which flows forth from... the will... is principally called the purpose; but that which flows forth from... the understanding and its thought is called the intention; and guilt is predicated principally of the will...
That the Divine love continually intends conjunction. Signified.
These are murders in intention, but not in act... That hatred is murder. Signified. The reason is that everything which is of intention is also of the will, and thus, in itself, is of the deed.
The reason is that concupiscence is as a deed when it is in the will... for the intention is in the will, and the intention of concupiscence is deed.
This infinite diversity between the goodwill of one and of another, originates from the end, the intention, and the consequent purpose...
In the seed... are concealed, as it were the end, intention, and purpose of producing fruits...
As a temple of God, man has salvation and eternal life as his end, intention, and purpose. In these there is a correspondence with the will, in which these three are.
The quality of any love is predicated from the end which it regards and intends.
As the will inflows into all things of intention... and the understanding into all things of thought...
A robber, who directs his mind... after booty.
That true repentance is to explore intentions of one's will. General article.

The root is torn up... when the man explores the intentions of his will, and removes the evils by repentance. A man explores the intentions of his will when he explores his thoughts; for in these the intentions manifest themselves...
If he directs his mind to this...
When anyone is... intending evil, he should say to himself, I think this, and I intend this; but as it is a sin I will not do it. By this the temptation injected by Hell is broken...
As the end is the purpose, and this intends, purpose is also of the will, and through intention enters the understanding...
The whole sphere opposes the things which the Angels intend.
That they are as it were intentions...
The evil... can better penetrate the thoughts and intentions of others than the good.
That when evil Spirits intend evil to the good, the communication is at once closed.
Without any intention of hurting him...
These thoughts are as it were thinking intentions...
It is in (the interior sphere of the World of Spirits) where the intentions of men, or their ends, reign...
In this sphere, which may be called a sphere of intentions...

Those Spirits... do indeed inflow into the thoughts of man, but do not perceive them, but only their intentions; and therefore when such intentions are absent from man, these Spirits cannot understand...
An art innate in them through almost continual intentions in the life of the body...
In the interior sphere are intentions or ends ceasing in the world and in self: such natural intentions or ends exist more at this day...
When anyone intends evil actually, the like is reflected from me upon him. Explained.
That... Spirits see all the thoughts of man, and... his intentions.
Interior Spirits have a speech still more interior; namely, one of intentions.
With such force... was the intention (of the infants) directed, that it could not be resisted...
a. The intention for which they wanted to be so subtle reigned in everything else...
The innumerable applications of the lungs to the several muscles... according to all the intention and will of the thought...
From his answer, the Angels could clearly perceive the intention he had had...
The Angels perceive at once from a man's answer what kind of an intention he has had...

Nor do the Angels perceive anything except the intention, end, or will. They do not know their words. Therefore, when the intention, end, or will... is good, the words may fall in whatever way they do fall...

They entered... into each and all things... of the intentions, and extinguished, suffocated, and perverted them, so that nothing could be thought, because they had taken possession of the intentions, even of intentions of which I was completely ignorant, and which were within the sphere of my perception.
If anything to be done comes into intention, thus into will and into act...

These loves... turn all their thoughts and intentions to self and the world... and in proportion as man's thoughts and intentions are turned to his hereditary proprium... they are turned away from Heaven... (But) when a man loves God above all things... the Lord turns the interiors of... his thought and intention to Himself...

The life which is in the works is the intention which is of the will and of the derivative thought... Hence the wise do not look at the works, but to this life in the works, namely, at the intention. This is especially done by the Angels who are with the man: hey do not see his works, but only the intentions of his mind; and thence infer the quality of the man's state.
Then the Lord from the Sun directs His virtue... to protect the Angels...
7. 2. The love produces from itself affections, of which are the intentions...

2. The end intends, or wills to do what it loves... The Lord... from His Divine love perpetually intends, or wills, to do uses... Man... being in the love of uses... in this love intends, or wills, to do uses.
The tables and the heaps of books upon them were... representations of the intentions of the mind and of the consequent deeds, according to which (they) will be judged.

The intercession of the Lord for the human race... His intercession for those with whom truths were adjoined to goods, and with whom there were goods through temptations... or through other states. Signified.

The intercession of the Lord for the human race was when He was in the world, and indeed when He was in a state of humiliation... But in His state of glorification... He does not intercede, but pities, and... aids and saves. It is mercy itself which is intercession, for such is its essence.
Intercession from love, that they should not perish. Signified.
The grief and intercession of the Lord for those who are in evil, but still in some good and truth. Treated of.
Intercede for me with Ephron...
) = those with whom the truth and good of faith can be received.
To
intercede,
here, = to be prepared to receive.
Intercession for those who are in falsities and who infest. Signified.
Why criest thou to Me?
= that there was no need of intercession; (for) to
cry to Jehovah
= to intercede for deliverance from temptation.
As to there being no need of intercession, the case is this. Explained.
Interior lamentation and intercession. Signified.
As by
Moses cried to Jehovah

is signified intercession by Divine truth... it shall be told in a few words what intercession is... They who do not know what intercession is, (think) that the Lord continually prays the Father and intercedes for the sinner who supplicates devoutly...

With intercession the case is this. In all love there is intercession, and therefore in all mercy... That he who loves... continually intercedes, may be evident from examples. A husband who loves his wife... continually intercedes for her... From these examples it may be evident that intercession is constantly in all love. The case is the same with the intercession of the Lord for the human race, and in special for those who are in the good and truth of faith... Xor does He pray the Father for them, and thus intercede... but He continually excuses, and continually forgives...

An arcanum which lies still more interiorly concealed in the word intercession shall also be told. The Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord intercedes in this way continually, because it proceeds from the Divine love. When the Lord was in the world He was Divine truth... And as there is continual intercession in the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine good, it is said that the Son asks the Father, and intercedes for man.
Mediation and intercession. Signified.
Mediation and intercession are of Divine truth, because this is proximately with the Divine good which is the Lord Himself.

How the case is with the mediation and intercession of the Lord... shall be told... These... have no other idea about mediation and intercession than that the Lord... brings the supplications of men to the Father, and asks that for His sake... He will forgive... Such an idea about mediation and intercession exists with every simple person from the sense of the letter...

But he who knows the interiors of the Word has an entirely different notion about the Lord's mediation and about his intercession, in that He does not intercede as the Son with the Father... but as the Lord of the universe with Himself... The reason He is called the Mediator and Intercessor, is that by
the Son
is meant Divine truth, and by
the Father
Divine good; and mediation is effected by means of Divine truth; for by it there is approach to Divine good... Hence it may be evident what mediation and intercession are.

It is to be told further whence it is that the Lord Himself, who is the Divine good itself and the very Sun of Heaven, is called the Mediator and Intercessor with the Father. When the Lord was in the world, and before He was fully glorified, He was Divine truth, and therefore there was then mediation, and He interceded with the Father; that is, with the Divine good itself. Illustrated. But now that He has been glorified as to the Human, He is called Mediator and Intercessor from the fact that no one can think about the Divine Itself unless He presents to Himself an idea of a Divine Man; still less can anyone be conjoined with the Divine Itself except by such an idea... Hence it is that the Lord as to His Divine Human is called Mediator and Intercessor; but He mediates and intercedes with Himself.
A certain Spirit... solicitously asked that I would intercede for him, that he might come into Heaven...
There is much difference between them...
For whom the Lord intercedes...
By the intercession of the Son...
There is no other communication between them...
That He is reconciled by... intercession...
Three Angels... were associated with me, in order that I might speak from interior perception... concerning mediation, intercession, propitiation, and expiation...
Intercession signifies perpetual mediation; for love itself... perpetually intercedes, that is, mediates, for those who do His precepts...
The saints cannot help sion... by intercession...
The intercession... or redemption, of the Lord, intervenes...
By intercession is meant perpetual remembrance from love.
By intercession is meant the perpetual remembrance of man by the Lord.
To intercept the communication... of higher things with lower. Signified.
This interception or desolation of truth. Signified.
As the influx of good and truth is intercepted...
That before the Last Judgment... much of the communication between Heaven and the world, thus between the Lord and the Church, was intercepted. General article.
(Then) the communication with their neighbours was intercepted. (The consequence.)
So that they intercepted the spiritual light and heat...
It would intercept the communication of the Lord with men...
Lest the communication and conjunction of man with the Heavens should be intercepted... it pleased the Lord to reveal Divine truth by means of the Word...

So long as these expanses remain, there is intercepted with men the communication with the angelic Heavens... and when this communication is intercepted, all the truth and good of the Word are falsified and adulterated.
The intercourse of conversation (with Spirits).
This is the true intercourse of the soul with the body...
By a like intercourse with the Angels...
This is why the learned discuss only hypothetically concerning the intercourse of the soul and the body.
On influx, and on the intercourse of the soul with the body. General article.
He who does not know the interiors of man, cannot know the influx and intercourse of the soul with the body; for the intercourse and the influx are effected through the interiors.
Hence it is evident what is the intercourse of the soul with the body...
It has been granted to hold intercourse with the Spirits and Angels of... Jupiter longer than with the Spirits of the other planets.
On this Earth there is an intercourse of all nations... Such an intercourse has been provided by the Lord for the sake of the Word.
In the most ancient times, men were informed about heavenly things... by immediate intercourse with the Angels...

The inhabitants (of the Third Earth) are instructed about the things of Heaven by a certain immediate intercourse with Angels and Spirits, into which they can be brought the more easily, because they reject corporeal things from their thought and affection. Described.
Because the Lord led (the Most Ancients), they had intercourse with the Angels, and thence were in heavenly wisdom from the Lord.
The Angels of one Heaven cannot hold intercourse with the Angels of another...
In the World of Spirits there is a like intercourse of one with another...
Let the intercourse of our conversation be by means of questions and answers.
That such a friendship may exist between old married partners, experience testifies from their... intercourse, tranquil, secure, lovely, and full of courtesy.
On the intercourse of the soul and the body, or concerning the operation of the one into the other, there are three opinions... (See
Beyond these three opinions concerning the intercourse of the soul and the body no fourth opinion is possible...
This can be more closely illustrated by the mutual intercourse of the soul and the body...
That charity itself is to act justly and faithfully... with those with whom one is in any intercourse. General article.
If this intercourse with Spirits were taken away from man, he would die in an instant.
The Angels Know a man... from a short intercourse with him...
Intercourse of conversation (with the Africans).
No one observing that I had such heavenly intercourse.
With these Spirits it is not easy to establish an intercourse...
Thus there would be an intercourse of Souls, Spirits, and Angels with men...
It has been ordained by the Lord... that there should be such an intercourse...
As they can steal nothing from them they have no commercial intercourse with them.
I spoke much to the Jews concerning their commerce in the world.
In the life of the body she had intercourse with the same Spirits...
On the intercourse of the soul with the body.
He is numbered among the vile and wicked, with whom there must be no intercourse.
Because intercourse with (the Babylonians) is dangerous, especially in the Spiritual World...
The Lord... teaches mediately through the Word, by preachings, readings, speech, and by intercourse with others...
Therefore such intercourse (with Spirits) was interdicted to the sons of Israel...
Trinity. 2. 9. He who knows the intercourse of the soul and the body...
It is not read anywhere in history that such intercourse with Angels and Spirits (as I have enjoyed) has ever been granted, since the creation of the world.

From that time this has lent a light.
By thefts... are also meant thefts not manifest, as unlawful interest and profits
Who abstain from thefts, that is, from unlawful profits and interest.
The works of merchants are all evil, so long as they do not regard and thence do not shun as sins unlawful profits and unlawful interest. (Or, unlawful gains and unlawful profits.)
In order that this may gain some light, it shall be illustrated by comparisons.

There is no pleasure (except) from some interior affection; and there is no interior affection (except) from an affection still more interior...

Interior things are not manifest so long as men live in the body, except to those who reflect. They manifest themselves, for the first time, in the other life, and that in the order in which the men are elevated towards Heaven... Interior affections... manifest themselves in the World of Spirits; still more interior ones... in the Heaven of angelic Spirits; and still more interior ones... in the Heaven of the Angels... But so long as man lives in the body... these interior things are as it were lulled to sleep, because they are immersed in corporeal things...
External sight comes forth from interior sight, and this from sight still more interior, and so on. It is the same with every sense, and with every pleasure.
There are with every man things interior and exterior. The interior things are rational things... and affections. Signified.
Being more interior, it is much more perfect...

Every Spirit has communication with the interior and the inmost Heaven... otherwise he could not live. His quality interiorly is known by the Angels, who are in interior things... Thus communications of his interiors exist in Heaven, as of his exteriors in the World of Spirits. By the interior communications he is disposed to use...
The interiors with the Lord were celestial... The interiors with Him were Divine from Jehovah His Father; the exteriors were human from Mary His mother.
(Thus) the interiors of man are in a certain unknown activity, from which the quality of his spirit is perceived.
The hereditary evil from the father is interior...
Interior things can see what is exterior; but exterior things can never see what is interior. Example(s).
What is exterior is also lower, as what is interior is also higher.
Interior things, or those of the mind...
Their heat... was interior...
Spirits who do not want to hear anything concerning the interior things of the Word...
A vision with those whose interiors are closed is quite different from what it is with those whose interiors are open. Example(s).
Visions are more perfect the more interior they are.
In the Lord's Kingdom there are external, interior, and internal ones... Angelic Spirits... are interior.
By instruction the interiors are formed, and thus the internals...
Interior and exterior celestial and spiritual things. Signified.
They hate the interiors of the Word; that is, the Truths of faith themselves; for these are the interiors of the Word.
Mistress
= the affection of interior truth.
The interior hearing... The interior sight...
View... from the interior into the exterior is called influx...
The things seen (there)... are more and more interior...
In the other life the interiors are open, and are manifested by a sphere, diffused from them.
The interiors of man are conjoined with his externals through the heart and lungs...
The interior sphere of the World of Spirits, where those are who have been interiorly evil as to their intentions and ends, is in like manner filled up (with evil Genii and Spirits).
The interiors (of Christians represented).
The more they were elevated from (scientifics)... the more interior were their perceptions.
Then the Angels remove further off, that is, more towards his interiors.
When the infants... are in the interior sphere, namely, the angelic one, they cannot be infested...
The interior memory. (See

Exterior things, namely, scientific, worldly, and corporeal things, are adequate to man... in the body; but interior, namely, rational, spiritual, and celestial things, are adequate and correspond to his spirit.
Interior things inflow into exterior, or, what is the same, higher things into lower; but not the reverse...
Exterior things cannot enter into interior things; just as composites cannot into simples...
With those in love truly conjugial the interiors of the mind are opened... even to the Lord...
The interiors (of adulterers) are closed, and cannot be opened, except by serious repentance.
The door of the inner gate looking towards the north
the
place
where
are
interior
falsities.
The door of the gate of the house of Jehovah towards the north
= where are interior evils. That there are interior falsities and evils, and that there is an interior sphere in which are such Spirits and Genii. References.
Everyone is (to be) in freedom as to the interiors, that is, as to the affections and thoughts...
Interior truths were revealed by the Lord (when He was in the world).
Exterior and interior Knowledges. Explained.
Then the inmosts, the interiors, and the externals act as one.
Their interiors are in darkness, whence also their body becomes dark. Signified.
The case is worse with those whose interiors are dark, and their exteriors appear as if lucid... They are called
Babel
The Natural as to good interior and exterior. Signified, Explained.

Interior truth in the Natural is that which is conjoined with the interior good of the Natural; and exterior truth is that which is conjoined with the exterior good of the Natural. Interior truth is called natural truth, and exterior truth is called sensuous truth.
That is said to be
in the heart
which is interior and proceeds from good; and that is said to be
in the mouth
which is exterior and proceeds from truth.
All speech... when it ascends towards the interiors...
(Thus) there are interior kinds of speech in order... Enumerated.
What comes forth in an exterior speech is representative of an interior one.
For all perfection increases towards the interiors.
That the Lord left interior truths. Signified, Explained.
To see posterior or exterior things, without anterior or interior things, is to see nothing of the Divine.
Man's interiors are in the light of Heaven, and his exteriors in the light of the world...
Interior truths thereby. Signified, Explained.
For of interior things is predicated state... but of exterior things, doctrine.
Those in the good of truth... are regenerated as to interiors, which are their rational things; but not yet as to exteriors, which are their natural things...
When the interiors begin to be illustrated...
These are the planes in which his interiors are terminated. As, therefore, these are disposed, so do the interiors become when they inflow...
Unless what is lower is from interior things (or from higher things), as an effect from its efficient cause, it does not come into existence.
But the interior things which inflow are not such as they appear in externals; but have an entirely different face, sensation, and pleasure. Correspondences teach their quality...
The neck
= the communication of interiors with exteriors...
For the singulars of interiors appear as one... in the exteriors.
The apparent entrance from nature into interiors. Signified, Explained.
But exteriors cannot inflow into interiors...
As these interior goods and truths are open... in the Christian Church, and are profaned...
The removal of those who are of the Church from interior goods and truths to exterior ones... Signified.
(Interior truth; and the affection of interior truth. See
Every natural affection, when it ascends towards the interiors... becomes milder, and is at last changed into a heavenly affection.
Those in the charity of faith, as to the interiors are in the light of Heaven...
Some species of trees = interior goods and truths... others, exterior goods and truths. Enumerated.
The disposing of the power of interior truth. Signified, Explained.
Many flocks
= interior goods and truths.
The interiors (of the brain)... are according to the interior forms of Heaven...
They were not interior Spirits.
Interior Angels spoke through him.
In the Society of such is every man as to his interiors; that is, as to his thoughts and affections.
As he suffers himself to be led to more interior... good, so is he brought to more interior... angelic Societies.
Goods and truths... which are interior are component, and those which are exterior are composite.
Interiors can never be seen from outmosts, but outmosts can from interiors.
There are with man two planes... one interior, and the other exterior...
The interior plane, or interior conscience, is where are good and truth in the genuine sense...
Evil not of blame... does not penetrate to the interiors...
The Lord rules the interiors (of the good gentiles), which are in obscurity...
Interior things appear as higher... Hence
high
= what is interior.
Few know what what is interior is...
These purer or interior forms... are what produce the interior affections. To these forms... correspond the interior Heavens.
Goods and truths exterior and interior which are to be of service. Signified.
Those in the Representative Church communicated with the Heavens as to the interiors... But those in the representative of a Church did not communicate with the Heavens as to the interiors...
There is a sphere which exhales from man's interiors which Spirits perceive...
Goods and truths are said to be destroyed when there are none interiorly.
The reason was, that their interiors were filthy and profane...

The affection of external truth is more interior, and the affection of interior truth is still more interior. The more exterior things are, the more general they are; and the more interior, the less general...
, Explained.
For man progresses successively towards interiors, and infills generals with particulars, and particulars with singulars.
Remote presence, which is the same as presence more interiorly.
The interior truths of faith which are those of tranquillity. Signified.
Especially when coming from exterior truths into interior ones is the state untranquil...
, Signified.
He who does not know the interiors of man and their states...
The Church when vastated... principally perishes as to the states of its interiors...
Those of the old Church... are in a kind of inundation as to the interiors...
Interior truth is the first of light. Signified.
That they extinguish truths even to the interiors. Signified.
There, as the interiors are open, they are in a perpetual endeavour to destroy others...
No one... can be brought to interior things until the truth with him has been made good.

What progression towards interiors is, is little known... It is not progression into scientifics; for this... often exists without any progression towards interiors... Nor is it progression into manly judgment; for this also sometimes exists together with egression from interiors. Nor is it progression into the Knowledges of interior truth... Progression towards interiors is progression towards Heaven and the Lord by Knowledges implanted in the affection of them; thus by affections.

The quality of the progression towards interiors, does not appear to anyone in the world, but manifestly in the other life... For they who are solely in exteriors are relatively in a mist... whereas they who are in interiors are in light...
As it treats of the progression of the Lord's Divine towards interiors, Jacob is here called
Israel.
Progression of what is holy towards interiors, Signified, Explained.
For interior things are expressed by things lofty and high... The reason is that interior things appear before minds... as higher ones. Illustrated.
Here, the interiors and exteriors of their loves are described by
cedars,
oaks,
mountains,
hills,
a tower,
and
a wall
... Thus interior things by those which are high...
For he who teaches faith and not charity can never apperceive the higher or interior things of the Church...
But they who are celestial men... perceive interior things...
Interior natural truths. Signified, Explained.
Interior truths are conclusions from exterior truths or scientifics...
Potiphar the chamberlain of Pharaoh
= the interior things of scientifics.

Some correspond to the interiors of the tongue and lips, and some to the exteriors. They who receive exterior truths only with affection, but not interior ones, but still do not reject the latter, (operate) not into the interiors but into the exteriors of the tongue.
All the interior affections (of the Angels) appear clearly from their faces... Hence it is evident that the face corresponds to all the interiors in general, both his affections and his thoughts.
They were amazed at such a disagreement between the interiors and the exteriors.
Because interior things disturb the delights of their life...
They thereby shut themselves out from innumerable things which might have inflowed from the Spiritual World, if they had acknowledged interior things...
With some (worldlings) the interiors are open towards Heaven...
They are interior wicked ones. Described.
To
go down
... = from interiors to exteriors; to
go up
= from exteriors to interiors.
This state is more interior than the former.
For the merely natural man does not acknowledge interior things; and therefore when exterior things are taken away... they are at once dissociated.
For man does not know the interiors; but in the other life... the interiors are open...
When yet man as to the interiors is continually in the society of Spirits and Angels.
When they apperceive that he is interiorly protected by the Angels...
But the Angels defend him from within...
For his interiors are then open towards Heaven.
The influx of the heavenly Societies is... perceived only by those whose interiors are open...

In the preceding chapter it treated of the interiors of the Natural being made new... But now it treats of the exteriors of the Natural, which are to be reduced to... correspondence with the interiors...

There are interiors and there are exteriors of the Natural: the interiors of the Natural are scientifics and their affections, but the exteriors are the sensuals of both kinds... The latter... man leaves behind when he dies; but the... interiors of the Natural he carries with him into the other life... thus all the interiors of the Natural...
Relatively to interiors, all exteriors are ministers.
Faces
= interiors... thus affections; for the interiors of man, from which are the thoughts which are also interiors, are affections...
Interior degrees can exist and subsist without exterior ones; but not exterior ones without interior ones. Example(s).
The interiors with the Angels are then in the most complete wakefulness.
For exteriors cannot possibly inflow; into interiors...
There is an influx of interiors into exteriors.
New states then commence, which proceed both ways; namely, more towards interiors, and also towards exteriors. Explained.
To be
lifted up,
or
elevated,
= to progress towards interiors... and as it is towards interiors, it is towards Heaven; for Heaven is in interiors.
Exterior or lower things are servants; but interior or higher ones are relatively lords.

That... exteriors ought to serve... interiors is unknown to the sensuous man... He does not know what interior is, thus not what is relatively exterior... He supposes that to think and will is interior, and to speak and act exterior... And as with him the communication with the interiors is closed, he does not know what interior thought and interior will are. If he is told that interior thought is to think from truth, and interior will to act from good, he does not at all apprehend it; still less that the interior man is distinct from the exterior...

Hence it is evident that the interiors and exteriors of man; that is, his rational, natural, and sensuous things; must be reduced to correspondence, in order that they may receive the Divine influx...
For when a man is in interior thought from affection... he is in rational apperception... But when he is in exterior thought... his apperception is from the interior Natural...
The more exterior apperception is, the more obscure it is; for exteriors are relatively generals; for innumerable interiors appear as one in the exterior.
Head
= interiors, especially those of the will.
That the interiors were without termination anywhere in the middle. Signified.
The interiors with man are distinguished into degrees...
Hence a man who lives in good is as to the interiors a Heaven in the least form; that is, his interiors correspond to the three Heavens.
Because the interiors with a man who is in space appear as higher things, and the exteriors as lower ones...

Nay, in the interior Heaven there is no idea of interiors and exteriors... but of a state more perfect or imperfect; for interiors are in a more perfect state than exteriors, because interiors are nearer the Divine...

No one can apprehend what the interior is relatively to the exterior, unless he knows how the case is with degrees... A man has no other conception of what is interior and thence more perfect than as of what is purer in continual diminution... As there is such an idea about the interiors of man, it cannot be apprehended otherwise than that exteriors cohere with interiors continuously, and thus act completely as one; but if a genuine idea is formed about degrees, it can be apprehended how interiors and exteriors are distinct from each other; so distinct, that interiors can exist and subsist without exteriors, but never exteriors without interiors; and it may also be apprehended how the case is with the correspondence of interiors in exteriors, and also how exteriors can represent interiors.
The order is inverted when interiors receive dominion over exteriors, and exteriors begin to serve interiors, both as to intellectual and as to voluntary things.
Because he denies at heart the things which are higher or interior.
(Thus) with the regenerate, interiors have dominion over exteriors; but with the unregenerate, exteriors over interiors.

The man who is in the sensuous things of the exterior Natural sees interiors almost as he sees affections in a face, and still more interior ones in the eyes. Without such an interior face... man in the body cannot think at all about the things which are above sensuous things; for he sees them there as when a man sees the affections and thoughts in the face of another without attending to the face itself... The case is the same with the exterior Natural: unless this served interiors as a plane in which interiors may see themselves as in a mirror, the man could not think at all. Therefore, this plane is the first formed... But these things are unknown, because the things which come forth interiorly with man are not manifest without interior reflection.
In the light of Heaven, by this face, interiors shine forth, especially the intentions or ends...
Hence it may be evident what... the exterior Natural is; its quality when subject to interiors; and its quality when interiors are subject to it.
When there is no subordination, the man can have no interior thought...
How exteriors are reduced into order, and to correspondence with interiors, through good, by means of scientifics and truths...
The man who is in good is re-born every moment... not only as to his interiors, but also as to his exteriors...
The wisdom of the Ancients was to cultivate interior things...
Because what is exterior never thinks from itself, but from what is interior... although when the interior thinks in the exterior... it appears as if the exterior thought from itself...
Twice
= concerning both Naturals, the interior and the exterior.
The looking forward (of the Natural) is from the interior; this looks forward in the exterior...
The conjunction of interiors with exteriors by the action of good. Signified.
All... thought in... the exterior comes from... the interior, although it appears to be from the... exterior...
(The Israelites) could not be reformed as to the interiors; for they completely rejected interior things.
The conformation (in the skins) with those with whom these extremes correspond to the interiors... was beautiful...
Child
is said, because that which is interior is... called
a child,
because there is more innocence in the interior than in the exterior.
Also our infants
= the things still more interior...
For the exterior exists and subsists from its interiors in order.
Spiritual life exterior and interior. Signified, Explained.
The interior thought itself of the man who is in good apprehends this...

As the interior mind... of the man who is in good is in the Spiritual World, and his exterior mind... is in the natural world... both minds must think, but the interior spiritually, and the exterior naturally...

The things which are exterior are signified by such things as are less noble. The reason is that in themselves exteriors are grosser than interiors; for they are generals compounded of very many interiors.
An almond
= the perception of interior truth.
To such an outermost in the body have they departed from interior things...
a. 2. For, when the interiors are closed, the man can know nothing whatever about influx.
Hence it may be evident how much at this day the interiors disagree with the exteriors.
Because the medium is more interior; and the interior abounds in goods more than the exterior.

Few... have known that the interior is distinct from the exterior; so distinct that they can be separated; and when they are separated, the interior lives, and the exterior dies; but so long as they are conjoined, the exterior lives from the interior. If this had been known, it might have been known... that in the interior there are a thousand things which appear as one in the exterior; for the interior is in a purer sphere, and the exterior in a grosser...
For conjunction to come forth, everything lower or exterior must be completely subordinated and subjected to what is higher or interior.
For progression takes place in order from exteriors to interiors... for exteriors must afterwards serve as a plane for interiors.
Thus interiors, as they act through exteriors, are relatively essentials.
Thus have they closed the interiors to themselves, and have opened externals...
They seem not to be obsessed, when yet they are so as to the interiors, but not as to the exteriors...
More than others they had closed the interiors to themselves; thus those things which are of the spirit.

It is from Divine order that interiors must betake themselves into exteriors; or, what is the same, prior things into posterior ones... Unless this is done, the man cannot be fully regenerated; for by such a bringing in of truths into scientifics, the interiors and exteriors agree and make one, which would otherwise disagree; and if they disagree, the man is not in good...

When a man cannot be regenerated, the remains... are reserved in the interiors; but when a man is being regenerated, they are remitted from the interiors into the exteriors... because by regeneration the interiors are conjoined with the exteriors, and act as one...
The head
= the interior; and this relatively to the body, which is exterior.
Therefore, the more interior things are, the more indefinite (in number) they are.
The interior truths and goods which come afterwards. Signified.

The reason interior things are signified, is that the things which are afterwards generated from the Internal are more interior... For man is first sensuous; afterwards he becomes more and more interior...
In this lumen are they who have not at all cultivated interior things...
Thus have they closed interior things to themselves...
The lower or exterior form being dissolved, the higher or interior form still lives.
Affects his interiors with ineffable happiness...
For what the interiors are, and what they will be... no one can know except the Lord.
Because the interiors of man are represented in Heaven by animals of various kinds.
They who do works from truth... cannot so much close interior things to themselves; for the plane in which the interiors are terminated is the Natural...

The bliss of the affections cannot inflow, unless natural and sensuous things have been reduced to agreement with the interiors; and not even then, except obscurely... But after death... it affects both the interiors and the exteriors.
With good and truth from the interior. Signified, Explained.
Heaven from above
= from the interior; for the Heaven of man is in his interiors; for a man who is in the good of life, as to his interiors is... in Heaven, and as to his exteriors... in the world.

In man is an inmost, interiors under the inmost, and exteriors. All these are most exactly distinguished from each other... Life inflows through the inmost into the interiors, and through the interiors into the exteriors... and as the interiors inflow... down to the ultimate, and there rest, it is evident that interiors are in the ultimate simultaneously; but in this order, - the inmost... holds the centre, the interiors which are under the inmost encompass the centre, and the exteriors constitute the circumferences...

As all the interiors are simultaneously in the ultimate, there is an appearance as if life were in the ultimate... when yet it is in the interiors; and not even there, but... in the Lord... It is from this that the life in the exteriors is obscure relatively to the life in the interiors; for in the exteriors the life is general, coming forth from the influx of... innumerable things from the interiors...
That in the Natural also there are interiors and inmost. Signified.
That the inmost and the interiors are also simultaneously in the exteriors, thus in the goods and truths in the Natural...

This obscurity becomes clear in two ways: First, if the exteriors are reduced to compliance with the interiors... Secondly, if the man can be elevated from exteriors to interiors, and thus to see exteriors from the interiors. This exists with those who are in the internal of the Church; the former with those who are in its external...
That all the interiors are in order in the good and truth in the Natural. Signified.
As to his lower things in which are the interiors... Signified.
This is the Natural to which the interiors betake themselves...
Concerning the coming forth of interiors in exteriors, it is to be known further, that all things... come forth by successive formations...

These things are said that it may be known... that interiors and exteriors succeed in order; and also that all interiors are simultaneously in exteriors; or, what is the same, all prior things in posterior ones. Treated of.
Everyone has life according to the form of the interiors...
In the Spiritual World, man is in the sphere of his interiors...
All influx comes from the interior, and never any from the exterior.
When with the evil this influx... advances into the exteriors, it is resisted... and then... the interiors are closed...
Thus the truths of faith and goods of charity... are more interiorly implanted...
Thus is the man... constantly led towards the interiors; thus more interiorly into Heaven.
To
ascend
= to be elevated... towards the interiors which are of the Church.
For that which acts interiorly prevails immensely over that which acts exteriorly; because the interior, being purer, acts into the... individual things of the exterior...
When a man thinks about such things... if he is in good, he is elevated... towards the interiors...
Of this the man is ignorant, because he does not know that the interiors with him are distinct from the exteriors; and that thought is more and more interior, and also exterior...
That the interiors were protected... lest they should be injured by the presence of the Divine Itself. Signified.
Elevation towards the interiors is elevation from infestation by falsities to the truths and goods of faith. Signified.
Elevation to interior and more spiritual life in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
The interior with a man in the world cannot appear until the exterior has been removed; for the exterior with the evil acts quite otherwise than the interior wills and thinks...
That the interiors are such, is still more manifest from the evil in the other life...
That the interiors disagree so much with the exteriors, is a sign that the state of man is completely perverted...
The chambers of kings
= interior truths: (or) interior falsities.
That (reasonings) will fill the mind even to its interiors. Signified.
Bed-chambers
= the interiors of the mind because they are interiorly in the house.
Chambers
= interior things; and
bed-chambers,
still more interior things. Illustrated.
In the other life, when... the man is left to his interiors...
That thence were interior and exterior evils of cupidities. Sig and Explained.
Interior evils are distinguished from exterior evils by this, - that interior evils are those of the thought and will, and exterior evils are of the act...
If evils do not appear by falsities, they are hidden in the interiors...
That the interiors also of the natural mind will be occupied by the falsities of evil which are in the extremes of that mind. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as truths are turned into falsities the interiors... are closed...
The inflowing truth is there perverted, and then the interiors are closed. Therefore, when the exteriors are regenerated, the whole man is regenerated. Signified.

When, therefore a man is regenerated as to the Natural also, then all things there are subordinate to the interiors; and when the interiors inflow there, they inflow as into their generals, by which they present themselves sensibly to the man...

Sometimes truth from the Divine appears to the evil... but It does not inflow with them through the interiors as with the good; for the interiors with them are closed; but it only affects their exteriors...
For the interiors of those who receive are open to Heaven.
Nor are their interiors open to Heaven, but to the world.
Which are from interior and exterior evil. Signified, Explained.
When such are left to their interiors (in the other life), then falsities burst forth...
He does not know that interior thought exists according to the perception of truth and good because his interiors look downwards...
For wherever the love turns itself, thither the interiors of the man turn themselves...
Interior lamentation. Signified.
Because the greater the lamentation is, the more interior it is.
For the interiors of man actually turn themselves where the love turns itself.
A state of the initiation of the interiors. Signified, Explained.
As remains are in the interiors.
That interiors and exteriors must be conjoined; that is, act as one. Signified.
Interiors are the things of the internal man; exteriors are those which are of the external...
That in the interiors, where good is, truth shall be appropriated. Signified.
Dwellings
= the things of the mind, thus those of intelligence and wisdom, consequently the interiors...

As to appropriation being effected in the interiors, and that good is there, it is to be known, that with those who are in the Lord... good dwells in the interiors; and the more interiorly it dwells with them, the purer and more heavenly is the good: whereas truth dwells in the exteriors, and the more exteriorly it dwells in them, the more is truth bereaved of good. The reason is, that man as to his interiors is in Heaven... but as to his exteriors he is in the world...

(The Spirits of Jupiter) are susceptible of a happiness still more interior. This is perceived by their interiors not being closed, but open to the Lord; for the more open the interiors are, the more susceptible they are of receiving the Divine good and the Divine happiness.
(But) with those who do not live in the order of Heaven, the interiors are closed, and the exteriors are open to Hell...
If a man exalts himself before the Lord, he closes the interiors of his mind for the reception of good and truth from the Lord.
The interior and the exterior Angels of the Spiritual Kingdom. Explained.
Thus the man as to his spirit is introduced more interiorly into Heaven.
The lower or exterior things with the man who is being regenerated, receive life from the higher or interior things successively...
Through the inmost, and thus through the interiors to the exteriors...
The Divine order is, that the Lord should inflow through the interiors of man into his exterior.
When a man does what is good for the sake of self... the interiors are closed...
The ordination of the interiors to undergo temptation as to truth. Signified, Explained.
It is said the ordination of the interiors, because truth and good constitute the interiors of the man of the Church.
The Angels dwell with men in their interiors; but where there are no interiors, they dwell in the interiors of simple Spirits...
Falsity from interior evil. Signified and Treated of.
Interior evil. Explained. (See

Each and all things in universal nature come forth in order from interior things... but interior things do not cohere with exterior by continuity; but are distinct, and are conjoined by exsertions like fibres, by which are the communications...
The communication of interiors with exteriors (in fruits) is effected in a wonderful way by passings over
which
are
as
it
were
fibrous.
At
first,
when
they
are
being
formed
these
almost
cohere,
but
in
course
of
time
they
are
separated...
In the animal kingdom (too) there are exteriors, interiors, and inmosts...
From morning even to evening
= in every state, interiorly and exteriorly.
In the other life they are interiorly in good and truth when in the morning state... but exteriorly in good and truth when in the state of evening.

Influx does not take place from exteriors to interiors, but from interiors to exteriors. The reason is that all exteriors are formed to serve interiors as instrumental causes do their principal causes; and the former are dead causes without the latter.
Thus do truths pass from exteriors to interiors successively...
The veiling over of the interiors that they may appear now and afterwards in holy faith. Signified, Explained.
For all influx takes place through intermediates from interiors to exteriors, and not from exteriors to interiors.
These are the interiors which with those who are of the Spiritual Church are stored up and as it were veiled over...
No elevation to interior things which are Signified, Explained.
For the Lord is more present in interior things...
In the World of Spirits, elevation to interiors appears... like an ascent by steps.
With those who are in the life of good, the interiors are open into Heaven... But with those who are in the life of evil, the interiors are closed towards Heaven, but are open into Hell...
If they shall injure anything in the interior understanding. Signified, Explained.
Man has exterior understanding and interior understanding. Explained.
An insult from the affection of evil against the truths and goods of faith derived from interior things. Signified, Explained.
For interior things are like parents...
If he should see it clearly from the interior. Signified, Explained.
If interior good does not admit of conjunction. Signified, Explained.
Because from interior good as a father, and from interior truth as a mother, are conceived and born exterior truths and goods...
When the Lord came into the world, and opened the interior things of worship, and... the interior things of the Word. The interior things of this law are...
When a man is in interior things, this law ceases... This law is not binding upon Christians, to whom interior things have been revealed...
That interior things shall have rest upon the Sensuous. Signified, Explained.
Upon these things the interiors rest; for they cease in them.
Prior or interior things have a connection with ultimates in successive order. Therefore, if the ultimates disappear, the interiors also are dissipated.
Extension from scientific truths to the interior truths of faith. Signified, Explained.
As all interior things cease in the ultimate...
Whose interiors have been opened, so that they can hear those who are speaking from Heaven...
For, as to his interiors, man is a Spirit and Angel.
With others, the interiors cannot be opened...
The interiors constantly regarding good, thus the Lord. Signified, Explained.
Heaven and the Church... are guarded by the Lord by means of an elevation of their interiors to Himself...
Even into the interiors and inmosts (of Heaven), where truth is in light. Signified, Explained.
For, in the Heavens, light... increases towards the interiors...

The state of good to which the east corresponds, and the state of truth to which the south corresponds, are interior states; and the state of good to which the west corresponds, and the state of truth to which the north corresponds, are exterior ones; for the more interior a state is, the more perfect it is; and the more exterior, the more imperfect, thus the more obscure. Hence it is that the higher a man can be elevated towards interior things, the more he comes into the perception of good and the light of truth...
Whereby it looks towards the interiors of Heaven. Signified, Explained.
If a man does not suffer himself to be regenerated, all his interiors remain determined towards the world...
More interiorly, in Heaven, is nearer to the Lord...
The Divine truth there in the external form, in which interior things cease. Signified, Explained.
That which is outermost not only contains interior things, but interior things also cease in it...

As interior things present themselves simultaneously in the ultimate, the ultimate, if the order is perfect, is held as more holy than the interior things; for there the holiness of the interiors is filled full.
For when the Lord... is in the ultimate, the interior things are held together in their order, connection, and form...
Ephod
is said from the enclosing of all interior things.
For the outermosts derive their essence from the interiors; and therefore when the interiors are unclean, so are the outermosts...
To take away the externals... so that the interiors may be seen. Signified.
From the interior of the scientifics of good in every direction. Signified, Explained.
That all things of doctrine and worship must be from the interiors of the scientifics of good. Explained.
Lest the interiors of the love, which are filthy and infernal, should appear. Signified, Explained.
Lowest and natural things are more defiled with evils and falsities than interior things... For interior things are not in the world, but in Heaven...
The ordination of exterior things under interior and inmost ones. Signified, Explained.
Whether you say higher and lower things, or interior and exterior ones, it is the same... References.
It is there evident how interior things communicate themselves with another... by the touch; and how the other receives them according to his love.
When an Angel... determines his sight to others, his interior things are communicated and transferred into them...

So long as a man is merely natural, his interiors, which see from the light of Heaven, are closed; and his exteriors, which see from the light of the world, are open... But when a man becomes spiritual, his interiors... are opened...
Degrees of height proceed from interiors to exteriors...
The things in an interior degree are more perfect than those in an exterior degree; and there is no likeness between them, except by correspondences...

It may be likened to a flower, tree, or animal, the perfection of which increases towards the interiors; for that which has been created by the Divine, the more interior it is, the more perfect it is. This is very evident from the representatives in the other life...
, References.

Nothing of man is purified unless the outermost things are purified; for the outermost things are those into which the interior ones inflow... Therefore, if the outermost things have been perverted, the interior things are perverted therein...
For all their interiors are turned outwards, almost as are the interiors of animals...
For Divine things increase in perfection towards the interiors...
The interiors are actually elevated, and are then actually withdrawn from the body and the world. When this takes place, the man's interiors come actually into Heaven, and into its light and heat...
These Spirits keep themselves at a distance, because their correspondence is... with the interiors.
The interiors with (the Israelitish people) were completely closed. Treated of.
They were entirely in corporeal and earthly loves; and, with those who are in these loves, the interiors
